review: Great for any team that has an abundance of Envy. Middle Meursault is a unit that can be slotted into teams that has envy nukes and assists in setting them up with his Skill 2 and Skill 3. On his own, though, he isn't anything too special. He relies too much on Envy Resonance to be genuinely viable in content with Railway and Focused Encounters. He's simply a unit more on the fun factor. E.G.O. Synergies Electric Screaming - In Middle/Envy resonance team, its spam allows for great dmg output each turn.
